gloss: broad daylight, middle of the day

definitions.gloss: broad daylight, middle of the day
definitions.explanation: The brightest part of the day, emphasizing that it is clearly daytime with full sunlight.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}から{寝|ね}ている。
{真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}にそんなことをするなんて。
examples.english: To do such a thing in broad daylight!

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}の{繁華街|はんかがい}で{事件|じけん}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: An incident occurred in the busy downtown area in broad daylight.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
{真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま} often carries a nuance of surprise or criticism when used with actions that would normally occur at night or in private. The emphasis on 'broad daylight' suggests the action is inappropriate or unusual for that time.

VARIANT:
{昼間|ひるま} is the neutral term for 'daytime,' while {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま} emphasizes 'right in the middle of the day.'
